candidate_method.aggregate: minimum anchor score across all target anchors and physical channels
candidate_method.amplitude_component: (candidate early_rms/late_rms)/(target early_rms/late_rms), early=6 ms, late end=24 ms
candidate_method.anchor: target-only 4 ms pre/post RMS contrast; >= max(0.05, 0.25*target peak contrast); <=8 anchors/channel; >=12 ms separation
candidate_method.inactive_target: neutral 1.0 only when target has no qualifying anchor; existing activity/silence gates stay authoritative
candidate_method.onset_component: candidate target-anchored normalized positive pre/post RMS contrast divided by target contrast
candidate_method.spectral_component: target-applicable attack-local high-band contrast ratio using cutoff min(1000 Hz,0.20*sample_rate), target fraction floor 1e-4

compatibility.evidence: InverseValidation 1.0.0 retains raw per-anchor components and method id; inverse implementation/feature identity changes.
compatibility.old_records: Historical v1 records keep derivative-anchor meaning through their stored implementation identity; rejected research v2 candidates are research evidence only.
compatibility.policy: ValidationPolicy.min_transient_ratio remains 0.4 with no threshold migration.

decision_rule.confirmation: Fresh confirmation v2 decides acceptance. All preserved cases ratio >=0.4; all damaged/adversarial cases ratio <0.4 unless a separate unchanged hard gate directly demonstrates the declared damage.
decision_rule.no_retuning: No candidate parameters or confirmation-v2 fixtures may change after results are inspected.
decision_rule.raw: Report v1 derivative baseline, rejected v2/v3 research candidates where available, and final v3 raw components.

design_history: Confirmation v1 rejected the prior candidate: a removed secondary onset retained aggregate ratio 0.8310780175536643. The failure is structural, not a threshold problem: amplitude and high-band contrasts did not directly test whether target onset contrast survived. This revision adds that missing target-anchored onset-contrast component and leaves every threshold/window/cutoff unchanged.
